decisions.subject: link_coa's lat/long/ward inheritance runs as a declared post-link join_update arm in runCascadePhase, the twin of the entities-contacts arm
decisions.recommendation: The target is the draft descriptor's existing set_based_join_update on the cascade table that is not the name-equal link plan (no new descriptor field, CHAT-108; not positional, CHAT-139/147). It runs only when declared and only when the compute exports its statement (buildPostLinkSql(descriptor, config) returning the count statements, the UPDATE and its binds), through the LG-11 executor, after the link writes and in its own statement transaction (legacy order; core.12). Its counters are the keys the compute returns (coaInheritedFromPermit, coaWardFilledFromPermit, coaLatLngUpgradedFromPermit, coaWardMismatchWithPermit kept as the data-quality signal). ward = COALESCE(ca.ward, bp.ward) as legacy (CoA ward authoritative); a declared check counts fills whose permit ward is outside the CoA ward range (01-42 today), WARN, so a ward-scheme mismatch is observable (R-JB). Legacy parity proven by link_coa PRE vs POST captures and a C0-style golden. Built as a separate patch on top of R-JY so the running OUTPUT panel's review stays valid; it gets its own PLAN and OUTPUT panel before the re-freeze night applies it.
